proof: Positive moment coefficients make the fixed-profile moment strictly increasing in its saving. Both rational engines reject complex_upper, so the admissible complex saving is smaller. Every retained outer witness has kappa < epsilon*q = (1-eta)*q/(1+q) < a/(1+a) < b/(1+b), using eta>0, q=a*(1-2eta), and the strict complex_above_bit constraint b>a. Monotonicity therefore gives the displayed ceiling. No attainability or construction optimality is asserted.
scope: Only the unchanged physical paid profile and retained outer recipe. Changed profile, controller, primitive law or outer construction is outside this ceiling.
